stem: Based on events in the story “Biking for Boots,” which sentence best expresses its theme?
instruction: Use “Biking for Boots” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: A month later Shelby and I left from Duluth, Minnesota, on the first leg of our lengthy Lake Superior bicycle tour. (paragraph 8)

options.label: G
options.text: Already we had a list of over a hundred pledges from family and friends. (paragraph 8)

options.label: H
options.text: Yet, throughout the journey, we met many friendly people who cheered us on and kept us motivated. (paragraph 9)

options.label: J
options.text: I knew that despite the challenges, the Forest Animal Shelter was a cause worth biking for, especially if the animals there were all as sweet as Boots! (paragraph 12)
